note: Story locks on map objects, where the roads out go, and the repeatable shift jobs (Spec 14.5a, 15.5). places are where a route can take you (the map and the spawn you arrive on). routes are exits with a choice of places at the end (an exit whose to is world_map, a name kept from the old world map screen so the maps did not change): the route marshal by the exit (npcs.json, guide: true) says where each goes and lets you pick, then you leave by the exit. Without a pick, leaving by the exit asks where to, so the marshal is never in the way. Pay is in pounds per part. testPayMultiplier boosts all shift pay while testing (Boss: 10× for Alpha v1): set it back to 1, or remove it, before Final v1.
